To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the NIDOS/Silicon structures are more robust than the other structures; (ii) the out-diffusion of nitrogen atoms from NIDOS film towards SiO 2 is the main reason for the nitridation of SiO 2 ; (iii) the nitridation is related to the N 2 O annealing process; (iv) the dielectric breakdown improvement cannot be related to the NIDOS nitridation process; (v) the
NIDOS-ni-tridation does not improve the dielectric breakdown properties of MOS structures.
the NIDOS layer, when deposited on a thin oxide layer, is responsible for an improvement of the breakdown properties of MIS structures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the breakdown properties of NIDOS/SIO 2 /silicone structures.
the breakdown properties of metal/insulator/semiconductor (MIS) capacitors.
the optimization of NIDOS/SO 2 /Si structures for the fabrication of high-voltage devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NIDOS film is the key element for the dielectric breakdown improvement.
the polysilicon film is the main factor for the dielectric breakdown improvement.
the dielectric breakdown properties of the metal/SiO2/Si structures are improved by using a NIDOS polysilicon layer instead of the usual polycrystalline polysilicon.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the polysilicon film is the most important factor in the improvement of the breakdown properties.
NIDOS-nitrification process can lead to an enhancement of the dielectric breakdown properties of the MIS structures.
NIDOS is a good candidate to replace the polysilicon film as gate material in MOSFET devices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the NIDOS/SIO 2 /Si structures can be used as a good candidate for future non-volatile memory devices.

the NIDOS layer should be as thin as possible in order to reduce the nitridation level and the polysilicon thickness should be as high as possible in order for the NIDOS to act as a barrier against nitrogen atoms out-difussion.
NIDOS-nitrated SiO 2 /Si structures can be successfully applied for the realization of MIS devices with improved breakdown properties, even if the NIDOS layer is not intentionally nitridated.
